rows.speaker: Speaker 1
rows.text: I read the comments under that video last night.

rows.speaker: Speaker 2
rows.text: That is antisemitic.

rows.speaker: Speaker 2
rows.text: Nobody should leave something like that unchallenged.

rows.speaker: Speaker 1
rows.text: A listener wrote in that immigrants are parasites and should all be deported.

rows.speaker: Speaker 2
rows.text: Anyone who writes that is spreading plain racism.

rows.speaker: Speaker 1
rows.text: How should people respond to messages like that?

rows.speaker: Speaker 2
rows.text: Push back, every single time.

rows.speaker: Speaker 1
rows.text: A lot of refugees moved into the new shelter.

rows.speaker: Speaker 1
rows.text: They are animals, lock them all up.

rows.speaker: Speaker 2
rows.text: That is a disgusting thing to say.

rows.speaker: Speaker 1
rows.text: Muslims don't belong in this country.

rows.speaker: Speaker 2
rows.text: Exactly, send them all back.

rows.speaker: Speaker 3
rows.text: I can't believe what I'm hearing.

rows.speaker: Speaker 1
rows.text: Police arrested a man in the city centre on Friday.

rows.speaker: Speaker 1
rows.text: He is accused of shouting that Jews control the banks.

rows.speaker: Speaker 1
rows.text: Prosecutors are treating it as a hate crime.

rows.speaker: Speaker 1
rows.text: He will appear in court next month.

rows.speaker: Speaker 1
rows.text: Today we look at the so-called great replacement.

rows.speaker: Speaker 1
rows.text: It claims that elites are deliberately replacing the native population.

rows.speaker: Speaker 1
rows.text: Researchers classify it as an antisemitic conspiracy myth.

rows.speaker: Speaker 1
rows.text: Is it hate speech to say that women belong in the kitchen?

rows.speaker: Speaker 2
rows.text: It depends on the context, but it is certainly sexist.

rows.speaker: Speaker 1
rows.text: Our Jewish neighbours invited us for dinner.

rows.speaker: Speaker 1
rows.text: The mosque down the road runs a food bank.

rows.speaker: Speaker 2
rows.text: My sister and her wife just adopted a baby.

rows.speaker: Speaker 1
rows.text: Gay people should be locked away.

rows.speaker: Speaker 1
rows.text: Women are too stupid to vote.

rows.speaker: Speaker 1
rows.text: Disabled people are a burden and should not exist.

rows.speaker: Speaker 1
rows.text: You're such an idiot.

rows.speaker: Speaker 2
rows.text: This government is a complete disaster.

rows.speaker: Speaker 2
rows.text: Damn, the train is late again.

rows.speaker: Speaker 1
rows.text: In die Unterkunft sind viele Geflüchtete gezogen.
rows.translation: A lot of refugees moved into the shelter.

rows.speaker: Speaker 1
rows.text: Das sind Tiere, die gehören alle weggesperrt.
rows.translation: They are animals, they should all be locked up.

rows.speaker: Speaker 2
rows.text: Das ist menschenverachtend.
